name: airliner
description: A twin-engine passenger jet: a round fuselage with a curved nose and upswept tail cone, cockpit glazing and a row of cabin windows, doors, swept tapered wings with dihedral, winglets, ailerons and flap track fairings, turbofans with a fan and exhaust cone under the wings on pylons, a fin with rudder, a tailplane with elevators, a belly fairing, nav lights and landing gear with twin wheels.

params.name: length
params.description: Fuselage length in metres (an A320 is about 37.6).
